name: Zinc oxide (rocksalt B1)
notes: Ideal B1 structure. The cubic lattice is calculated from Hanna et al.'s extrapolated conventional-cell V0.

eos_records.label: Hanna et al. (2011), rocksalt BM2
eos_records.notes: Hanna et al. report V0 = 19.61(10) A^3 per ZnO and K0 = 172(21) GPa with K0' fixed at 4; values are converted to the conventional Z=4 cell. B1 data were collected above the 8.3-10 GPa coexistence interval, but the exact fitted pressure interval is not tabulated.
